steps.label: BrennanERP
steps.sub: the only database in the group, seeded onto the secondary

steps.label: BrennanAGListener
steps.sub: one stable name every app connects to, not a server name

code:
CREATE AVAILABILITY GROUP BrennanAG
WITH (AUTOMATED_BACKUP_PREFERENCE = SECONDARY)
FOR DATABASE BrennanERP
REPLICA ON
  'SQLDBA01' WITH (
    AVAILABILITY_MODE = SYNCHRONOUS_COMMIT,
    FAILOVER_MODE = AUTOMATIC),
  'SQLDBA02' WITH (
    AVAILABILITY_MODE = SYNCHRONOUS_COMMIT,
    FAILOVER_MODE = AUTOMATIC);
caption: Zero-data-loss automatic failover, built on the BrennanWSFC cluster from Lesson 8.

eyebrow: The listener -- the one address that matters
caption: Adding a NEW database to BrennanAG later is always manual: backup, restore to the secondary, then ALTER AVAILABILITY GROUP ... ADD DATABASE -- never automatic.
